problem: Why is one good answer insufficient? What should change checks cover after editing descriptions or helpers?
principle: Separate selection, artifact quality and operating cost. Pair identical tasks with/without Skills and old/new versions; pin reviewed bytes for reproducible regression and rollback.
solutions: Compare selection and paired task quality
Fix model, tool snapshots and rubrics
Pin bundles, record traces, roll back
Example mechanisms, not a rollout platform
check: Do passing helper tests prove a 20% model success improvement?
answer: No. Deterministic correctness and model benefit differ; without paired measurements there is no improvement statistic.
